resources.string: Place the wallpaper subject in front of the tall clock. Import a matching background and transparent foreground first.
Smoothly reveal the clock and depth layers when the screen turns on. Motion pauses on AOD and in Battery Saver.
Choose a background and its subject as a transparent PNG. Both images must keep the same canvas and crop. Automatic subject extraction is not included. Applying selects the tall clock.
The complete wallpaper behind the clock.
A PNG cutout aligned with the background, with transparent space around the subject.
